result.title: ValQID: Learning the Net Value of Semantic Query Groups for Web Device Identification
result.summary: Web interfaces are widely used to access network services and manage networked devices. Identifying the vendors and types of devices behind Web interfaces is a critical step in asset inventory, security management, and risk assessment. Device identity cues are dispersed across page text, configuration fields, and management functions, and interpreting them often requires linking related Web objects. Responses and objects require different amounts of semantic analysis, so exhaustively processing all candidate content can introduce unnecessary computation. We present ValQID, which uses a relation graph to combine dispersed device identity cues, evaluates semantic questions efficiently with DSEJEV, and accounts for complementarity among semantic questions when estimating computation value. Based on the current identification state, ValQID weighs each question group's expected identification benefit against its execution cost and adaptively allocates computation to identify device vendors and types. Evaluation on real Web response data shows that ValQID achieves relative gains of up to 47.1% in joint macro-F1 and up to 82.1% in macro-F1 for low-frequency vendors over a state-of-the-art method. DSEJEV speeds up semantic processing by up to 8.58 times compared with general-purpose language models.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 ValQID，用关系图聚合分散在网页文本、配置字段与管理功能中的设备身份线索，并以语义问题组为单位权衡预期识别收益与执行成本，自适应分配语义分析计算，同时用 DSEJEV 加速问题评估。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「按预期收益与执行成本分配计算」的表述可能与 LVR 中 THINK/LOOK 的收益—成本权衡、证据筛选与停止决策同构，可供核查其价值估计是否显式依赖当前状态与问题间互补性。
